extensionName.message: Better Sidebar: pastas e busca para Gemini

extensionDescription.message: Organize chats do Gemini & AI Studio com pastas, tags, busca, prompts, exportação, sincronização Drive, ferramentas de IA e mais.

webAgentMenu.message: Deixar o Web Agent trabalhar nesta página
webAgentMenu.description: Context menu item that opens the Web Agent side panel for the current page

webAgentAddActive.description: Web Agent side panel toolbar: let the agent operate the active tab

webAgentAddAll.description: Web Agent side panel toolbar: let the agent operate every tab in the window

webAgentAddAllConfirm.message: Permitir que o Web Agent controle todas as abas desta janela? ($1 abas)
webAgentAddAllConfirm.description: Confirm dialog before adding all tabs. $1 is the tab count

webAgentNoTabs.description: Web Agent side panel toolbar: shown when no tab is under the agent's control

webAgentRemoveTab.description: Web Agent side panel toolbar: tooltip of the × that takes a tab out of the agent's control

webAgentCurrentRefused.message: O Web Agent não pode controlar esta página
webAgentCurrentRefused.description: Web Agent side panel toolbar: tooltip when the active tab cannot be operated (e.g. Gemini itself)
